DefaultDialogue: Normally,<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> I'd feel a bit overwhelmed being in such a dark place. Yet, I feel oddly exhilarated and in control.
<g id="female_bowDeep" />Greetings, Soulwarden. On behalf of Emperor-in-Waiting Zhou Liang,<g id="male_nodMild" /> I have come to offer the Dynasty's assistance to your cause.
And<g id="female_leanforwardWhisper01" /> on a personal note, I am glad to be here, both to see my friends, and to contribute in striking back against our vile enemy.
Oh<g id="female_recoilDisgustSmall" /> my. That is rather potent, isn't it? Well. Pus we need, so pus we shall use. Alchemy isn't always herbs and spices.
I think that went rather<g id="female_suppresslaugh" /> well, don't you? Worry not about the trigger.<g id="male_nodMild" /> I can handle that on my own when the time comes.
I'm<g id="female_leanforwardSmall" /> hoping if you talk to him, he'll soon be on his way… that man gives me chills.
I'm<g id="female_leanforwardSmall" /> hoping if you talk to him, he'll soon be on his way… that man gives me chills.
<g id="female_shrugDontcare" />Here we are, standing in a war camp on the very precipice of battle. When we met in<g id="female_lookLeft" /> Brightwood, I never could've imagined this.
<g id="female_shrugDontcare" />Here we are, standing in a war camp on the very precipice of battle. When we met in<g id="female_lookLeft" /> Brightwood, I never could've imagined this.
Thank you for speaking with me. It may not be my place to say so, but<g id="female_bowShallow" /> I think Yonas would be most proud of you.
Thank you for speaking with me. It may not be my place to say so, but<g id="female_bowShallow" /> I think Yonas would be most proud of you.
Liang will be overjoyed to hear of this rousing success! Perhaps now<g id="female_touchhands" /> we can know a second peace – and one to last a long, long time.

<g id="female_gesturebothhands" />Soulwarden... hopefully you didn't find me rude disappearing from the camp so suddenly. I<g id="female_cheerFistpump" /> simply needed to inform Liang of your success!
Commander Thorpe's defeat weakened<g id="male_fistpumpLargeRight" /> the Corrupted significantly in Great Cleave, and our positions have grown stronger.
Commander Thorpe's defeat weakened<g id="male_fistpumpLargeRight" /> the Corrupted significantly in Great Cleave, and our positions have grown stronger.
Here we are, then.<g id="male_gestureHereweare" /> The edge of the Tempest's domain... the Shattered Mountain beyond.<g id="male_guiltyLookdown" /> If only Yonas could have seen this…
Warden,<g id="male_casualHail" /> I would speak with you further, when you have time.
Don't get me<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> wrong, I'm grateful they're ignoring us for now. It buys us time to fortify our defenses,<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> but is that enough?
We cannot let up. Assaulting<g id="male_clenchFistRight" /> the mountain will require great preparation...<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> and great sacrifice, I fear.
I can feel the winds<g id="male_lookUpAround" /> of change blowing. Like the hand of Yonas on our backs, pushing us along to victory!
<g id="g_litearmor_complimentplayer" />I can't believe it. We've managed to amass quite a large and diverse force.<g id="g_female_explains" /> I do not think the Tempest is prepared for this.
<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Commander! All of our steps have brought us to this place at this time. We are all ready<g id="male_nod1" /> to attack on your orders.
<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Commander! All of our steps have brought us to this place at this time. We are all ready<g id="male_nod1" /> to attack on your orders.
You<g id="male_gestureAhead" /> have got this, Warden. I believe in you. Fully. Without hesitation.
You<g id="male_gestureAhead" /> have got this, Warden. I believe in you. Fully. Without hesitation.
<g id="male_nodMild" />It is only fitting that you signal the start of battle. Raise<g id="male_pointRight" /> the Soulwarden Banner on high when you are ready.
We<g id="male_cheerBothHands" /> have done the impossible! Yonas is avenged. And now he can rest, though his<g id="male_handheart" /> spirit will live on. In all of us.

Looks<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> like those fellows need an extra gun downstairs. Luckily, I have two!
Well, I never thought I'd see the day when you looked stumped, but here it is! Are you going to say something or just stand there?
Looks<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> like those fellows need an extra gun downstairs. Luckily, I have two!
Done and dusted!
<g id="female_shrugDontcare" />Well! No need to selfishly take all the credit. This was a shared victory,<g id="male_quidproquo" /> you and me. Look at us! Come a long way, we have!
You made it!
You made it!
We are with you,<g id="female_youknow" /> Warden, now until the end, come what may.
I wish Walker<g id="female_touchhands" /> could be here, but he said he<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> couldn't risk witnessing the loss of another Soulwarden…
<g id="female_shrugDontcare" />To think we are here at the very gates of Myrkgard. The Tempest… is<g id="male_gestureAhead" /> just over there…
Myrddin, come back! I don't understand. How can that save anyone? They hate us all. And I am too weak. Brother… Brother!
Myrddin, come back! I don't understand. How can that save anyone? They hate us all. And I am too weak. Brother… Brother!
Go on,<g id="female_beckonUrgent" /> go on. Despite her appearances, I sense she is quite kind. She may be receptive.
Hah!<g id="female_laughLarge" /> Our "woodsie friend" is quite the travel companion. Chatty as a magpie, turns out. Odd, but charming.
I am tired,<g id="female_crossarms" /> Soulwarden, but my wits being about me again, I recall... I came here for the Blighted Angry Earth.<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> But why?
Not<g id="female_nodshrugokay" /> my most elegant work. Still, it's something.
<g id="female_gesturebothhands" />We are on the verge of some discovery. Nonetheless, I'll be<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> damned if I know what it is.
<g id="male_nodMild" />As we've both witnessed, dwelling<g id="female_leanforwardSecret" /> in the past can be detrimental to one's soul, so let us focus on the task at hand.
Ah, Soulwarden. You see<g id="female_gestureBehind" /> our plan has come to fruition. Ancient Guardians are slow, but they<g id="male_nodMild" /> respond to my command, nonetheless.
Ah, Soulwarden. You see<g id="female_gestureBehind" /> our plan has come to fruition. Ancient Guardians are slow, but they<g id="male_nodMild" /> respond to my command, nonetheless.
I think you're more confident in my abilities<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> than I am… That's why I'm here, you know.
I think you're more confident in my abilities<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> than I am… That's why I'm here, you know.
Commanding the Ancient Guardians... that was a<g id="female_taptemple" /> heady experience! And, I fear, addictive. I<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> hope never to wield such power again.
Seems you're throwing yourself<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> at another problem with an immediacy that would make others blanch. Heh. I'm much the same.
The journal<g id="male_gestureLeft" /> is open to the passage you should read.
<g id="male_nodMild" />I knew this moment would come.<g id="male_sighRelief" /> That you'd be drawn here like a moth to flame, your light to shine in the darkness.

<g id="male_headShakeNo" />Now you know.<g id="male_guiltyLookdown" /> My life was restored just in time to witness my holy mission thwarted,<g id="male_convince02" /> my only hope that we would meet again.
Your comrades have confided<g id="male_crossarmsDoubt" /> to me some of your story. They say Isabella was making a game of tormenting you.
<g id="male_explain" />Now, you must simply open yourself up to her awareness,<g id="male_nodMild" /> and let us see how she reacts to such a psychic assault.
Here,<g id="female_spreadarms" /> now. Still your mind, release the fears she stirred up within you,<g id="male_nodunderstand" /> and invite her to trespass into your mind once more.
We<g id="male_convince01" /> have done it! If those relics meant nothing to her, as she claimed, she would not have reacted as she did.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> This is good news.
<g id="male_bowShallowPerfunctory" />I told you I'd find you again, Soulwarden,<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> and here I am. We must speak, and soon.
<g id="male_bowShallowPerfunctory" />I told you I'd find you again, Soulwarden,<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> and here I am. We must speak, and soon.
<g id="male_lookupSmall" />"And I saw a star fall from heaven upon the earth.<g id="male_gestureUp" /> And there was given to him the key of the bottomless pit."
<g id="male_headShakeNo" />Truly, I have not felt such<g id="male_handheart" /> hope and conviction in my heart since I first resolved to return here and face my sins.
<g id="male_headShakeNo" />Truly, I have not felt such<g id="male_handheart" /> hope and conviction in my heart since I first resolved to return here and face my sins.
You have triumphed<g id="male_explain" /> over countless Corrupted, but do not be overconfident.<g id="male_pointRight" /> Isabella is more formidable than ever.
Steel<g id="female_leanpointConvince" /> yourself, Soulwarden. You stand upon the threshold of Corruption's heart. It<g id="male_shakehead" /> may as well be the Gates of Hell itself.

"If<g id="male_lookDown" /> I shall go and prepare a place for you,<g id="male_headShakeNo" />	 I will come again and will take you to myself: that<g id="male_wipetear" /> where I am, you also may be."
Humans...<g id="male_think" /> such peculiar names. We wonder why?
Oh. A human is come.<g id="male_lookaroundStartled01" /> We give to you warning that there is much madness here.<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> An infection wide as branches spreading.
Did you transpose through<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> the greensie passage? We are fascinated by it, though it tickles our bark we find.
Ohh…<g id="male_hivemind" /> ohh... Huntress is unhappy... so so sad. She says you are trespasser, she wishes you to leave right away.
This rocky shelter<g id="female_headnodding" /> on the edge of the woodlands is the destination we seek.
Mora-gaen is very wise when she walks and talks with us. She<g id="female_explainS" /> asks if Blighted brethren can do more, make war with Corrupted.
Ohh! What is this? ::.Little<g id="male_hivemind" /> sister! Yes, we do! And brother! We hear you. Yes, yes, do not weep, we are here now.::

Human, we… I have a question. We are Angry Earth. But I am not<g id="female_worry" /> angry. Does this make me broken? A misshapen growth?

We will try to be as our rootsibling and find the "bow and arrows" within<g id="male_handheart" /> ourself. Lest she chide, calling us cotyledon.

We remained behind to bid you farewells. Human! Be<g id="female_spreadarms" /> well! The Huntress calls us back to the garden in convocation. We go<g id="male_nodMild" /> to listen.
Go, human, and trouble me no more.
<g id="sit_gestureleftM" />You…? Tell me, is it hubris or stupidity that brings you before me once again?

Greetings.<g id="male_casualHail" /> It is my honor to assist the Soulwardens in this endeavor. May the Heavens smile on us.
We know our enemy, therefore we shall<g id="male_clenchFistRight" /> overcome. The outcome is already as predetermined as the battle.
I can't do this anymore. It was too much… and what if it happens again…?
I'll stay with you if you like. Whatever you command, I will do.
<g id="female_gestureRightM" />I'm sorry, friend. Something important has my attention right now.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> Perhaps later?
You've made it! Good!<g id="male_sighRelief" /> Your exploits precede you, and we have need of your aid.
Blasted trap! Are you able to pry it apart?
Ho!<g id="male_casualHail" /> My fellow Soulwarden saves the day! Thank you for breaking that snare... I<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> truly thought I'd be stuck here for all eternity.

<g id="male_spreadhands" />Tomash is a bit overprotective at times.<g id="female_shrugDontcare" /> Just means he cares. But helping people is what I'm meant to do,<g id="female_smackfist" /> no matter the danger.
I hope<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> this means the residents of this place will get the assistance they need. I've done what I can, but it is far from enough.
